title: Autonomy Register — Section L: Tooling Dependencies
description: Section L of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007 §2.13. Records the tooling estate on which the system depends. Tool attributes are held once in the STD-EDS-005 Tooling Resource Catalogue; this section records which tools a given system depends on and at what version, so that the tooling configuration active at any point in the system's history can be reconstructed.

tooling_dependencies.description: [Mandatory for all systems at autonomy level 2 and above] One entry per tool on which this system depends. Empty array permitted only for level 1 systems with CAIO-recorded rationale. Updated within 5 business days of any change to the system's tooling dependencies. (Source of truth: CAIO office / CTO)

tool_ref.description: Catalogue reference in the format TOOL-YYYY-NNN. Must match an Active entry in the STD-EDS-005 Tooling Resource Catalogue. A reference to a Retired entry is a Level 1 governance incident under STD-EDS-007 §7. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

tool_version.description: The version, release, or build identifier of the tool as used by this system. Captured from the tool, not inferred from configuration. Where the catalogue records release channel as vendor-controlled continuous, record 'Vendor-controlled — not pinnable' and the date of last observed behaviour validation. (Source of truth: CTO)

lifecycle_stage.description: The AI lifecycle stage this tool serves for this system. A tool serving more than one stage is recorded once per stage. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

dependency_confirmed_date.description: Date the dependency and its version were last confirmed against the operating system. Must be within 90 days for systems at autonomy level 3 and above; within 12 months for levels 1-2. A stale confirmation asserts a version that may no longer be true. (Source of truth: CTO)

tooling_dependencies_next_confirmation_d.description: [Derived — do not set by hand] Computed as the earliest dependency_confirmed_date in tooling_dependencies plus the confirmation interval for the system's autonomy level (90 days at level 3 and above; 12 months at levels 1-2). Triggers a stale tooling flag when passed. (Source of truth: system — computed)
